# `try_parse_url`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

This is a special version of `parse_url` that performs the same operation, but returns a NULL value instead of raising an error if the parsing cannot be performed.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
try_parse_url(url, partToExtract[, key])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `url_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- try_parse_url, example 1
> SELECT try_parse_url('http://spark.apache.org/path?query=1', 'HOST');
spark.apache.org
```

```sql
-- try_parse_url, example 2
> SELECT try_parse_url('http://spark.apache.org/path?query=1', 'QUERY');
query=1
```

```sql
-- try_parse_url, example 3
> SELECT try_parse_url('inva lid://spark.apache.org/path?query=1', 'QUERY');
NULL
```

```sql
-- try_parse_url, example 4
> SELECT try_parse_url('http://spark.apache.org/path?query=1', 'QUERY', 'query');
1
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
